parent_objective: design an exact post-PPO repair/projection path for the M1069 medium-ramp proof washout
blocked_by: M1070 classified M1069 as coupled exact/public/family/source proof washout while broad gates passed
invalidates: running another medium PPO before designing exact proof projection
repairing only old row15/row16 while ignoring M1061 family-intersection failures

public_gates: M1071 must not use private holdout
M1071 must design a projection/repair path that includes exact active-set, old public replay, M1061 family-intersection, and source-diverse failed rows
M1071 must define acceptance order before any projection probe
forbidden_shortcuts: do not design a repair that ignores family-intersection failed rows

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns the M1069 proof-washout audit into a concrete projection/probe plan before any further PPO
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: repair/projection design only; no training, no promotion, no repaired checkpoint claim
stop_condition: stop if the design cannot include exact active-set and M1061 failed rows
stop if acceptance criteria would rely on private holdout
stop if the design would accept a candidate before exact proof gates
fallback_plan: if a projection design is accepted, route to a no-PPO projection probe from M1069 raw toward M1049 base
if projection design is not coherent, route to guarded PPO recipe redesign
if failed rows need a new corpus, route to failed-row corpus export before projection
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1070 recommends projection-first repair instead of another medium PPO run

hypothesis: A post-PPO repair/projection design can convert the M1069 raw proposal into a testable candidate by making exact and family-intersection proof retention first-class acceptance constraints.
success_criteria: design names base and raw proposal checkpoints
design includes old public replay failed rows
design includes M1061 family-intersection failed rows
design defines acceptance order and rollback conditions
no PPO actor training promotion or private holdout occurs
failure_criteria: design omits M1061 family-intersection failed rows
design accepts a repaired checkpoint before proof gates
decision_rule: M1071 may only design a repair/projection probe. It cannot run PPO, train actor, promote, or use private holdout.
